title: Theorem 9.28 family
statement: For a Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, a real number $\varepsilon$, and a nonnegative integer $k$, define a family of subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ consisting of those contained in the coordinates whose Boolean influence is at least $\varepsilon^2/I(f)^2\cdot 9^{-k}$, together with all subsets of cardinality greater than $k$, where $I(f)$ is the total influence of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
